customSplit.subtitle: Total Bill: {{currency}}{{amount}}
customSplit.infoMessage:
Assign each person a split type:

• Fixed - Set an exact amount for that person.
• % - Set a percentage of the total bill.
• Rest - Evenly divides whatever is left after Fixed and % allocations.

The total must reach 100% before you can save. Use the footer bar to track your progress.

appInfo.title: About TipMate
appInfo.description: TipMate is a Smart Tip Calculator App created to make tipping easier and more transparent. Whether you're dining out, getting a haircut, or any service where tipping is customary, TipMate makes splitting bills and calculating tips a breeze.
appInfo.story: TipMate is a Smart Tip Calculator App. It was created to simplify the tipping process and make it enjoyable for everyone.
appInfo.contactDescription: Contact us for support and feedback
appInfo.contactConfirmMessage: You are about to open your default email app to contact our support team. Do you want to continue?
appInfo.feedbackDescription: Your feedback is important to us in order to make TipMate better for you. Report us any bugs in our app, or any features you'd like us to add in the future.
